suit.description: SuitOS Agent Operating System — consult registry, load workflows, run validations

suit:registry.description: Query the SuitOS registry — agents, skills, workflows, projects, models, routing
suit:registry.template: Read .suit/registry/{{query}}.yaml and summarize its contents. Query: {{query}}

suit:workflow.description: Load a SuitOS workflow definition for the current task
suit:workflow.template: Read .suit/workflows/{{workflow}}.yaml and use it as the process for this task. Workflow: {{workflow}}

suit:validate.description: Run SuitOS review profile checks on the current changes
suit:validate.template: Load .suit/reviewer/profiles.yaml, select the {{profile}} profile, and run its checks on the changes made. Profile: {{profile}}

suit:memory.description: Write an Architecture Decision Record to SuitOS memory
suit:memory.template: Write a new ADR to .suit/memory/decisions/ADR-{{number}}-{{title}}.md following SuitOS conventions. Title: {{title}}, Decision: {{decision}}

suit:plan.description: Create a SuitOS execution plan using planner template
suit:plan.template: Load .suit/planner/template.yaml, create a plan for this task, and present it for approval before executing. Task: {{task}}

suit:commit.description: Hace un git add, diff y commit desde WSL con formato SuitOS: {emoji} {tipo}: {desc} (v{X.Y.Z})
suit:commit.template: Ejecuta en WSL: git status, git diff, git add -A (excluye secrets), y git commit -m '{emoji} {tipo}: {desc} (v{X.Y.Z})'. Tipo puede ser feature|bugfix|docs|refactor|chore. Si falta tipo o desc, pidelos. Mensaje: {{message}}
